reviews.content:
I love it overall but I have two small issues:

One and the most important is when resizing two windows who are snapped to each other, sometimes it resizes both of them, as they should, and other times they unsnap and only one resizes. 

The other issue I have is that if you resize a window to quickly it's a bit laggy, nothing crazy and it might even be a problem on my side, but still a bit annoying. 

Still a great mod overall, keep up the good work.
